verdict.rationale: First-party material describes 2FAS Auth as an "Open-source 2FA Authenticator App" and points users to a public GitHub repository to read and review the code, so the core of the story is delivered for the Auth product. 2FAS Pass, however, is explicitly described only as "source-available," which is not the same as an open license. No specific license is named anywhere in the evidence. Missing for 10: the named open-source license (e.g. GPL/MIT) for the repositories, open licensing for 2FAS Pass rather than source-available, and independent corroboration of the license terms.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
